notes:
Overview: FairWind is a mid-market fintech offering instant credit decisions and live pricing for SMB loans. They need sub-50ms p95 inference for conversational assistant and sub-10ms model scoring for reranking at peak traffic. Highly cost sensitive — will consider quantized variants and aggressive batching/caching but cannot sacrifice tail latency for credit decisions.

Context from discovery: product team (CTO + infra lead) ran an internal prototype on single-node FP16 and hit 70-120ms p95 at 1k concurrent sessions; costs ballooned. They asked about dedicated pools + kiln of smaller LLMs vs single large model. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations (quantization profiles + batching) and the perf benchmarking service.

Timeline / Recent activity:
- 2026-01-12: Lead created (inbound form) after whitepaper download (latency-economics).
- 2026-01-21: Intro call (Avery) — high level requirements, asked for reference architecture for low-latency scoring.
- 2026-02-14: SE deep dive (Diego) — collected token distribution, seq length histograms, QPS patterns. Uploaded sample traffic traces to drive.
- 2026-02-26: 90-min technical call (Fireflies ff_20260226_6b2c8a) — discussed fallback routing, KV caching, and quantized 4-bit options; legal joined for baseline security questions.
- 2026-03-05: Internal procurement check-in; requested pricing scenarios for dedicated pool with 99.9% uptime and p99 latency objective.

Requirements summary (customer language / paraphrase):
- Workloads: chat assistant (multi-turn, avg 60 tokens reply), reranking/real-time scoring (short contexts, strict latency), occasional embedding generation for analytics.
- Targets: p95 chat <= 50ms; p99 scoring <= 10ms; sustained 500 rps scoring peak, burst to 1k rps for 60s windows.
- Cost constraints: target TCO reduction vs current prototype >= 40% for steady-state; open to reserved capacity commit.
- Model preferences: prefer open weights (LLM family X-style) that quantize well; want Redwood-verified perf profiles and fallback to smaller low-latency variant.
- Routing/fallback: automatic fallback to CPU-backed cheaper model unacceptable for scoring; can fallback for chat but must be labeled and monitored.
- Observability: token-level cost/latency breakdowns, tracing hooks, and rollbacks for bad quality.
- Security: SSO (SAML), SOC2 compliance evidence, KMS integration, audit logs, and retention controls; data must stay in NA.

Redwood-specific asks and POC plan:
- Shortlist model variants and quantization profile suggestions (Optimize).
- 48-hour dedicated benchmarking run with real traffic replay (we'll supply traces). Measure p50/p95/p99, throughput, GPU utilization, and per-token cost.
- Show how automatic batching + prefix KV caching affects scoring latency; need config that preserves p99 <=10ms.
- Cost scenarios: hosted vs dedicated vs reserved pricing with committed ARR levels.
- Security packet: SOC2, encryption at rest/in transit, sample audit log format.

SE notes (Diego):
- Traffic histogram suggests many short sequences for scoring (<16 tokens) and long tail for chat. Good candidate for separate route: small low-latency quantized scoring model on dedicated pool + separate chat model with dynamic batching.
- KV/prefix caching likely high value for chat continuity; need to tune batch size cap for scoring route to prevent tail blow-ups.

Next steps (actionable):
- Redwood: schedule dedicated perf run (Avery/Diego) — target start week of 2026-03-15. Confirm VPC peering details and sample trace format.
- FairWind: finalize procurement window and provide signed NDA to proceed with deeper security data exchange.
- Arrange 60min demo of Optimize recommendations once initial perf run results available.

Blockers / Risks:
- Procurement timeline uncertain (finance closes budgets mid-April).
- Legal needs explicit encryption-at-rest wording and proof-of-key-control for KMS.
- Performance risk: if dedicated cluster cannot meet p99 <=10ms for scoring, they will pursue on-prem FPGA partner.

Stitch notes / quotes:
- "If we can't get the scoring p99 under 10ms, customers will notice and we lose throughput guarantees." — CTO paraphrase.
- "Cost savings need to be tangible — show me the delta with quantized 4-bit and batching enabled." — Product lead.

- drive:/FairWind/Benchmarks/2026/mar/dedicated-run-notes.md (contains traces and token histograms)
- drive:/FairWind/Redwood/procurement-deck-v2.pdf (pricing scenarios requested)
- Fireflies ff_20260226_6b2c8a (technical call transcript)

Sales play / recommended pitch:
- Emphasize Redwood Optimize quantization/batching suggestions and the dedicated pool SLA. Offer a timeboxed perf trial that demonstrates p99 guarantees for scoring route and clear TCO delta. Prioritize legal packet with KMS language to unblock security review.

Record last activity and owner followups: Avery to send perf-run checklist and VPC peering template on 2026-03-08.
